Introducing the **Prime Words Educational Posters** from Litera, the perfect visual aid for supporting early literacy development. Whether you are decorating a child's room or enhancing a classroom environment, these educational posters provide a vibrant learning backdrop.

Designed specifically for children aged 3 to 5 years, this poster set helps parents and educators reinforce foundational vocabulary while making learning visually appealing. The durable, high-quality prints measure approximately **48x68 cm**, making them ideal for decorating walls in nurseries, playrooms, or educational classrooms alike.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
